stories.title: Birkenhead man sentenced after violent attack on woman in Hawarden
stories.summary: A Birkenhead man has been sentenced after pleading guilty to assaulting a woman in Hawarden and a series of driving offences. Gordon Duncan, 32, of Devonshire Road, Birkenhead, appeared at Mold Crown Court today, Thursday 4 June, for sentencing.

stories.title: Pontblyddyn homeowner wins planning appeal after Flintshire Council refusal
stories.summary: A homeowner in Pontblyddyn has won a planning appeal after Flintshire County Council refused permission for a two-storey rear extension to his property.
